name: Fujiyoshida (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Fujiyoshida city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji.
history: Municipal flag of Fujiyoshida, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 4 May 1951.

features.role: Fujiyoshida city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji
